title: Let the host app supply its own permission policy
narrative: Fangore’s product needs permission rules defined by the application. He configures the harness once so composed packs from `fangore_compound_grants` are what the harness enforces.
implementation:
`MechaHarnessConfig` hooks (`get_access_policy`, `get_access_control`, `get_grants`) bind host permission packs through pyiv injection — not Settings bags or hand-wired constructors.

Covers: host DI access policy.
